# SOW Spec — Expense Calculator (Internal, new-build)

## Project Summary

Expense Calculator is an internal WebDesk project (no external paying client) to build a free Shopify Public App that lets Shopify merchants estimate business expenses against revenue using configurable expense-category rules. It is a new build with no existing site, targeting Shopify Admin as an embedded app. Total scope is a 250-hour lump-sum estimate; total cost is $0 because this is unbilled internal engineering time, not because the scope is trivial — the source technical SOW spans 40 sections covering a full calculation engine, multi-tenant store isolation, Shopify auth, save/history, and production deployment. Target launch: 2026-10-20, no hard deadlines beyond that. Design deliverable is HTML per D-DES-01, though no mockup revision cycle is currently budgeted (0 homepage / 0 other-page revisions — see Risks). Internal PM: Ajay T.

---

## Module-by-Module Scope

### Module 1 — Expense Calculator MVP Build (250 hours)

| Sub-item | Hours | Scope |
|----------|-------|-------|
| Full MVP build (undifferentiated) | 250 | Complete Shopify Public App per the client-provided technical SOW — embedded Shopify Admin app, calculation engine, expense module configuration, results + visualization, calculation save/history, multi-tenant store isolation, Shopify auth/webhooks, DB schema, testing, production deployment. |

**Total: 250 hours**

**Notes:**
- This is a single lump-sum estimate supplied directly at intake — no module-level effort breakdown was provided (no estimation spreadsheet exists for this project). Do not infer per-feature budgets from the source doc's section structure below; a real breakdown would require a separate estimation pass.
- Full functional detail lives in the source doc `Shopify_Public_App___Expense_Calculator.docx` (client technical SOW, §1–40). Key areas: calculator UI & input validation (§4–5); predefined expense modules — Cost of Goods, Marketing, Platform Fees, Payment Processing, Shipping, Apps/Software, Payroll, Overhead, Taxes, Misc (§6); centralized calculation engine supporting percentage / fixed / formula-based rules (§7–9); results display + donut/pie chart visualization (§10–12); calculation saving, history, and detail view with configuration snapshotting so historical calcs don't change when defaults are later edited (§13–15, §20); Shopify store-level multi-tenant data isolation (§16); Shopify OAuth/session/uninstall handling (§17–18, §26); relational DB schema (§19); security, error handling, and logging (§23–25, §27); performance/determinism requirement (§28); full functional/validation/isolation/auth/UI test coverage (§29–30); production deployment and env config (§31–32).

## Out of Scope

Per the source technical SOW (§34) — the following are NOT in this build unless separately approved:

- Shopify storefront / customer-facing calculator
- Custom Liquid/theme integration
- Shopify Billing / paid subscriptions (V1)
- Advanced analytics or advanced financial reporting
- Arbitrary custom formulas / custom JS formula execution
- User-created expense categories
- PDF export, CSV export, email reports
- Automated or third-party accounting integrations
- Multi-store consolidated reporting
- AI-generated financial recommendations
- Tax/legal advice or automatic tax/compliance calculations
- Payment terms / legal Ts&Cs (standard SOW Builder exclusion — sales/legal team owns separately)

## Risks & Assumptions

### Assumptions
- Project is internal (no external paying client) per sales confirmation on 2026-09-17; `total_cost_usd: 0` reflects unbilled internal time, not zero scope.
- 250 hours is a single top-line figure, not derived from a line-item spreadsheet.
- `client_legal_name: "WDS"` reflects self/internal classification, not an external legal entity.

### Risks
- **Project classification instability (Medium)** — this project has flipped between "internal" and "external client" across its intake history: originally internal, then explicitly corrected to a client engagement (contact `kirtan@webdeskinc.com` on file previously), now reverted to internal. If an external stakeholder at `webdeskinc.com` is genuinely involved, the FLAG-004 blocklist below is unverified and under-populated. Confirm before treating it as authoritative in either direction.
- **Unverified contact placeholder (Medium)** — `abc@webdeskinc.com` is a stated placeholder, not a scanned or confirmed real address. Replace before any downstream agent relies on it as a real block target.
- **No effort breakdown (Medium)** — 250 hours has no module-level source. If actuals diverge from the lump sum, there's no baseline to diagnose which functional area drove it.
- **No design/mockup cycle budgeted (Low)** — `design.tool: HTML` per D-DES-01, but mockup revision caps are 0/0, meaning no formal mockup iteration is currently planned. Confirm the team is building directly off the technical SOW rather than through an HTML mockup gate; if that's wrong, add a design phase before G2.
